research_question: Do the strongest route-level alpha components mined across every candidate branch remain positive and sufficiently frequent when their original timestamped streams are deduplicated and run through one global chronological slot?

fixed_selection.same_timestamp_winner: larger robust component score, then source rank, then lower candidate number, then route and symbol
fixed_selection.overlap_policy: reject entries before the selected open position's recorded exit

advance_gate.final_integrated_system_frequency_requir: at least one independent completed trade per calendar day

decision_contract.advance: Freeze the loaded component set, source blobs, causal deduplication and global arbitration unchanged, then reimplement the component logic in one NautilusTrader account.
decision_contract.reject: Do not lower the source positivity, minimum sample, deduplication or recent confirmation gates.
